paragraphs: See the entry Bar Elnatan (Nehushta daughter of Elnatan, II Kings ch. 24, v. 8).[^1]

notes.text: The named Miqra according to the Masorah text of II Kings 24:8 explicitly names Nehushta daughter of Elnatan. Hyman’s cross-reference to Bar Elnatan is retained as a textual pointer; no target or identity between biblical and rabbinic names is newly bound. No additional royal genealogy or chronology from the verse is imported.
